title: A tail in the water
hook: An animal’s body and surroundings interact.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The long tail is highlighted in the schematic water scene. Crocodilians use lateral movements of body and tail in swimming; the drawing does not model fluid forces or the role of limbs.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In the simplified swimming scene, which body part provides major propulsion for a crocodilian?
